snippet.title: NullbreakProtocolTrailer
snippet.description:
Nullbreak Protocol is a dark sci-fi arcade roguelite. Break through escalating rooms of fortified blocks, stack protocols into devastating builds, and push your run as deep as the system lets you before the core gives out.
Dark electronic industrial sci-fi atmosphere. Cracked systems, violet Vex-energy, one more run.

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4782420/Nullbreak_Protocol

🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/4KWTKk2cNQ
#indiegame #roguelite #scifi #arcade #gamedev #godotengine
